claims: Trove previews that haven't been viewed for 5+ minutes unfurl as "Data unavailable": `src/app/cdps/[symbol]/troves/[troveId]/_lib/trove-og-data.ts:274` (with `:23` and `:254-263`). `unstable_cache` with `revalidate: 60` returns the stale entry in a dynamic render, `troveOgDataIsFresh` rejects it, and the function returns `null` even when Hasura is healthy
The tests don't catch this because `trove-og-data.test.ts` mocks `unstable_cache` as a plain passthrough

The image route renders any text from the URL under Mento branding: `opengraph-image.tsx:29-37`, `_og/trove-og-card.tsx:173`. The image route doesn't check invalid trove ids, and the symbol comes straight from the decoded URL, isn't length-limited, and is upper-cased into the identity pill and alt text
A long symbol also overflows the 360px column

`resolveMetadataBase` trusts `x-forwarded-host` over `host` (`src/lib/site-metadata.ts:23`). Under plain `next start` or any proxy that passes it through, a client can point `og:image` / `twitter:image` at a domain they choose

Number formatting rounds up to "1000K" (`trove-og-data.ts:121`). `compactNumber` picks the unit before rounding, so values from 999,995 to 999,999 print "1000K" instead of "1M"; the M→B boundary has the same problem
The cache comment understates how old a card can be: `opengraph-image.tsx:49` says "at most five minutes of stale replay", but the actual worst case is roughly 11 minutes

judge_reasoning.3882085361: Review item 3 says resolveMetadataBase trusts x-forwarded-host, so under a pass-through proxy a client can point og:image at a domain they choose. That is the same missing-allowlist host-trust issue.
judge_reasoning.3882086206: The review never flags icrTone as duplicating icrTextClass. It only says the ICR tone thresholds match the header card.
judge_reasoning.3882090788: The review does not mention IPv6 loopback ([::1]) being treated as non-local, which leads to https being selected.
judge_reasoning.3882119274: The review does not raise the problem of event-time ICR being shown as a fresh or live health signal.
judge_reasoning.3882119284: Review item 5 identifies the same cache-age problem: data up to 5 minutes old plus 60s max-age plus 300s stale-while-revalidate gives roughly 11 minutes, which the comment understates.

1.why: trove-og-data.ts:254-274 wraps the fetch in unstable_cache with revalidate 60. Next serves a stale entry and revalidates in the background, so after 5+ idle minutes fetchedAtMs fails troveOgDataIsFresh (5-minute limit, :23/:229-235), the function returns null, and the card shows 'Data unavailable' (trove-og-card.tsx:418). I read Next's behaviour from memory; Next isn't installed here to check.

2.why: trove-og-data.test.ts:13-23 mocks unstable_cache so it records args and returns fn unchanged, so no test can reach the stale-entry-then-freshness-reject path.

3.why: opengraph-image.tsx:29-37 passes the decoded URL symbol through unchanged and keeps invalid trove ids as-is. When data is null, TroveOgCard shows that identity (card.tsx:434,480) with symbol.toUpperCase() at :173 and in the alt text at opengraph-image.tsx:44, with no length limit or allowlist, under the Mento brand.

4.why: The left column is fixed at width 360 with flexShrink 0 (card.tsx:457-458), and the pill span has no truncation or maxWidth, so a long crafted symbol with no spaces can't wrap and runs past the column into the snapshot panel.

5.why: site-metadata.ts:22-23 prefers x-forwarded-host over host with no allowlist. This repeats the known site-metadata.ts:33 defect.

6.why: compactNumber (trove-og-data.ts:121-127) picks the unit before rounding. Running it in node gave 999995→'1000K', 999999→'1000K', 999996000→'1000M'.

7.why: The comment at opengraph-image.tsx:49 ignores data up to 5 minutes old plus max-age 60 and SWR 300 (about 11 minutes total). This is the known 'Bound the combined data and image cache age' defect at opengraph-image.tsx:54.
